description: This file defines the SavingsProduct class, which models a savings product in the Fineraft system. It includes various properties such as interest rates, lock-in periods, charges, and tax details, along with methods for creation, updating, and validation of savings product instances.

classes.name: SavingsProduct
classes.description: Represents a savings product configuration including interest settings, charges, account rules, and various other parameters. Facilitates creation, update, and validation of savings product instances.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a new SavingsProduct with all parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the current SavingsProduct instance with values from a JsonCommand, returning a map of changes.

methods.name: isCashBasedAccountingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if cash-based accounting rule is enabled.

methods.name: isAccrualBasedAccountingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if accrual-based accounting rule is enabled (either periodic or upfront).

methods.name: isPeriodicAccrualAccounting
methods.description: Checks if periodic accrual accounting is enabled.

methods.name: isUpfrontAccrualAccounting
methods.description: Checks if upfront accrual accounting is enabled.

methods.name: getAccountingType
methods.description: Returns the integer value representing the accounting rule type.

methods.name: updateCharges
methods.description: Updates the charges associated with the savings product, returning true if modified.

methods.name: applicableChart
methods.description: Placeholder method returning null, intended to find applicable interest rate chart for a given date.

methods.name: findChart
methods.description: Placeholder method returning null, intended to find interest rate chart by ID.

methods.name: minBalanceForInterestCalculation
methods.description: Returns the minimum balance for interest calculation.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the savings product.

methods.name: getShortName
methods.description: Returns the short name of the savings product.

methods.name: nominalAnnualInterestRateOverdraft
methods.description: Returns the nominal annual interest rate applied to overdraft.

methods.name: minOverdraftForInterestCalculation
methods.description: Returns the minimum overdraft amount for interest calculation.

methods.name: getTaxGroup
methods.description: Returns the tax group associated with the savings product.

methods.name: setTaxGroup
methods.description: Assigns a tax group to this savings product.

methods.name: withHoldTax
methods.description: Indicates whether tax is withheld.

methods.name: isDormancyTrackingActive
methods.description: Checks whether dormancy tracking is active.

methods.name: getDaysToInactive
methods.description: Returns days until account is marked inactive.

methods.name: getDaysToDormancy
methods.description: Returns days until account is marked dormant.

methods.name: getDaysToEscheat
methods.description: Returns days until escheat occurs.
